Author: @1pacarr
Comment: Very simply explained for those that seem confused, if the camera shoots at 60 Frames per second and the blade spins at 60 revolutions per second the blade will look stationary as the revolutions and frames are synced.  In this video, the blade is moving around 70 revolutions per second, so  the blade looks like it's moving extremely slowly.
